articles.title: More flight delays expected after hundreds cancelled by air traffic control glitch - BBC
articles.description: Departures from a number of airports are affected by a technical problem affecting air traffic control provider Nats.
articles.content: Europe's busiest airline, Ryanair, reported on Tuesday that more than 65,000 passengers had been delayed by up to eight hours.
